name: SaleGen Marketing Toolkit
author: wpsalegen

sections.description:
Welcome to SaleGen Marketing Toolkit!
SaleGen Marketing Toolkit is your all-in-one toolkit for creating powerful marketing features on WordPress. Everything you need — in one fast, flexible, and lightweight package.

Forget juggling multiple plugins or struggling with bloated setups — SaleGen Marketing Toolkit is built for speed, simplicity, and seamless integration.

Each module works right out of the box and is designed to integrate perfectly with others, so you can focus on growth — not configuration.

Learn more: wpsalegen.com

What’s included in SaleGen Marketing Toolkit?

Contacts
Create and manage contact profiles with custom fields, groups, and tags.
– Fields – manage unlimited contact fields of various types with dozens of options and settings.
– Groups – organize and manage contact groups.
– Tags – add and manage contact tags.
– Generate contacts directly from your WordPress users.
– Import and export contacts easily via CSV.

Forms
Build simple or advanced forms quickly with the visual editor.
– Create forms based on your contact fields and customize settings individually.
– Personalize design with detailed styling options.
– Display or hide forms using conditional logic: logged-in users, guests, users who haven’t filled in the form yet, and more.
– Choose from multiple form types: simple submit, user registration, contact creation, login, or logout.
– Supports SMTP and PHP mail() — configure your own email server.
– Built-in captcha options: Honeypot, Google Recaptcha v2 Checkbox, Recaptcha v2 Invisible.
– Send custom email notifications to admin and contacts.
– Automatically assign contacts to groups or tags after form submission.
– Verify contacts with automatic field mapping from form to profile.
– Track detailed statistics of views, errors, and submissions.
– Review submissions in a dedicated admin panel.
– Export all form submissions with one click.
– Security first: built-in validation on frontend and backend.

Popups
Create flexible popups with advanced display options and conditional logic.
– Visual popup editor with ready-to-use fields and options.
– Customize design with detailed styling settings.
– Show or hide popups using conditional logic.
– Set triggers by time, scroll, exit intent, user behavior, date/time, language, IP, and more.
– Embed forms inside popups and combine with conditions.
– Track detailed statistics of events, views, and form submissions.

External services

This plugin connects to external services to provide functionality:

  1. Google reCAPTCHA:
    Service provider: Google LLC.
    The plugin uses Google reCAPTCHA v2 to protect forms from spam and abuse.
    Data sent: IP address of the user, reCAPTCHA response, and plugin’s secret key.
    Terms of Service: https://www.google.com/intl/en/policies/terms/
    Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/salegen-marketing-toolkit/ directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure your first module via the SaleGen Marketing Toolkit menu in the WordPress admin.
sections.faq:
Is SaleGen Marketing Toolkit free?

Yes, SaleGen Marketing Toolkit offers a free version with powerful features. A Pro version with advanced functionality is also available.

Can I import my existing contacts?

Yes, you can import and export contacts via CSV.

Does SaleGen Marketing Toolkit support reCAPTCHA?

Yes, Honeypot, Google Recaptcha v2 Checkbox, and Recaptcha v2 Invisible are supported.

Can I use my own SMTP server?

Absolutely. You can configure SMTP or use PHP mail() for sending emails.

Can I create multiple forms and popups?

Yes, there’s no limit. You can create as many forms and popups as you need, each with individual settings.

Can I use conditional logic to show/hide forms or popups?

Yes, you can set rules based on user login status, behavior, date/time, IP, country, and other conditions.

How can I track form submissions and popup events?

All submissions and popup interactions are tracked in a dedicated statistics dashboard in the admin panel.

Is SaleGen Marketing Toolkit compatible with page builders?

Yes, it works with Gutenberg and popular page builders like Elementor.

Is SaleGen Marketing Toolkit secure?

Absolutely. It includes frontend and backend validation, spam protection, and secure handling of all user data.
